dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Hmm, we don't have many bandages left... I should probably inform the village head the next time I see him.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're...?

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: I'm the best doctor in Aaru Village — that is to say, the only doctor in Aaru Village.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Though I'd say that my greatest specialty is bandaging wounds.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: People who get injured out in the desert often wind up here in the village, and they rely on me to treat their wounds.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Though Aaru Village consists of mostly children and the elderly, most of them are in good health and rarely get afflicted with any serious illnesses.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: As for minor ailments, I just give out medicine based on previous experience, and everything usually turns out fine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: See you. May you remain in good health.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if it's a serious illness then?

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Do you mean diseases as terrible as Eleazar?

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: I'm afraid that in such cases, even the researchers of Sumeru City might be of little help. The only thing they can do is leave it up to fate.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Of course, such cases would be very extreme ones.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: If anything beyond my control crops up... Then all I can do is to attempt to have them sent to the city.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happens in the case of very serious illnesses, then?

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Well, if something else comes up that's clearly beyond my abilities... then I can only attempt to send them to the city.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Well, Lesser Lord Kusanali was able to cure something as awful as Eleazar, so I reckon the Bimarstan under her Akademiya must be pretty good, too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Victory and defeat are not that important. Don't worry, be happy!

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: My, you really are skilled. I was so engrossed in the game! I bet our patients would really be able to put their troubles behind them with your help!
